title: [CORE] Disable session cookie
body:
Some user want to disable the session cookie for the admin.

There is some confusion about cookies and the use of cookies in conection with personal data. Therefore a lot of users and visitors are afraid of any cookie.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Personal i don't want any Cookie. And i want no cookie notice on my minimal website. A option without Cookie will be awesome.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: The cookie in the admin area is only for keeping the `SESSION ID`, is need it for know if the user is logged or not to the admin area.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: But why all users became this cookie? Is there no way to set the cookie only in admin, for users who login? Only for this cookie, i need to setup a cookie notice in EU or choose a other flat-file-cms.

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body: session cookie is a normal thing in the world wide web..

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
> Only for this cookie, i need to setup a cookie notice in EU [...]

The GDPR or the EU doesn't say that there has to be a notice for a system cookie. This cookie does not track or store any personal information.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: @wpPerformance Any other idea or an example of a CMS without session cookies?

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: I disabled session cookie for the front page, is enabled only when you go to the admin area.

comments.author: Participant 5
comments.body: And now we cant check on front is user logged-in, right? I added "Edit" button in Pages - easy navigation to edit content. Now this is gone? What personal information contain user session? How this relate to GDPR?

comments.author: Participant 3

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
